how_to_apply: Prepare the application on plain paper or in the attached Form B (Application for Position in the Project).

Form B asks for the post applied for with notification number and date, personal details, correspondence address, present position, educational qualifications, experience, names and postal addresses of two referees, and a signed declaration.
Form B also has a space for a recent photograph and for application fee payment details (bank name, DD / receipt number, amount). The notice does not state any fee amount.
Enclose self-attested copies of all certificates in support of the information given.
Email the filled-in application to [email protected]. The notice asks for receipt by 30 November 2026 and does not specify an email subject line.
Self-attested copies of all certificates supporting the information in the application.
Proof of enclosures, with the proof numbers written in Form B against qualifications, experience and present position.
Form B gives the university address as P.O. Central University Campus, Gachibowli, Hyderabad – 500 046, Telangana, INDIA.
important_instructions: The appointment is purely temporary, and appointees have no right to claim any regular appointment in the University. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the written test / skill test or at the time of joining. Only eligible candidates will be informed by email / letter at a later date. Under the declaration in Form B, a candidature may be cancelled without assigning any reason if anything in the application is found false at any stage.

content_sections.heading: About the Project
content_sections.text: The post is in the School of Chemistry, University of Hyderabad, Hyderabad. It sits in a time-bound research project funded by CSIR, titled "Investigation of the palladium-II/IV chemistry of functionalized alkynes – Cascade synthesis of oxa- and aza-heterocycles". The notice is signed by Prof. V. Sridharan of the School of Chemistry.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice prints one post, so the same conditions apply to the single vacancy. The age limit is 28 years. The upper age limit is relaxable up to 5 years for candidates belonging to SC/ST/OBC, women and physically handicapped categories. Form B asks for date of birth and age as on the last date of the notification. The notice prints no minimum age. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility terms of the post.

rows.essential_qualification: M.Sc./Integrated M.Sc. Chemistry/Organic Chemistry or equivalent degree with 55% marks and valid NET or GATE qualification
rows.desirable: Experience in synthetic organic chemistry lab

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The project tenure is one year, extendable to two more years based on satisfactory performance. The appointment is for a temporary period, purely on a contractual basis. The notice names no allowance such as HRA.

content_sections.heading: UoH Junior Research Fellow (JRF) Job Description
content_sections.text: The JRF will be responsible for carrying out research activities under the supervision of the Principal Investigator.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for UoH Junior Research Fellow (JRF)
content_sections.text: Prepare the application on plain paper or in the attached Form B (Application for Position in the Project). Form B asks for the post applied for with notification number and date, personal details, correspondence address, present position, educational qualifications, experience, names and postal addresses of two referees, and a signed declaration. Form B also has a space for a recent photograph and for application fee payment details (bank name, DD / receipt number, amount). The notice does not state any fee amount. Enclose self-attested copies of all certificates in support of the information given. Email the filled-in application to [email protected] . The notice asks for receipt by 30 November 2026 and does not specify an email subject line. Self-attested copies of all certificates supporting the information in the application. Recent photograph (pasted on Form B). Proof of enclosures, with the proof numbers written in Form B against qualifications, experience and present position. Form B gives the university address as P.O. Central University Campus, Gachibowli, Hyderabad – 500 046, Telangana, INDIA.

faq.question: Q1. How many JRF vacancies are there in the UoH School of Chemistry project?
faq.answer: There is 01 vacancy for the post of Junior Research Fellow (JRF) in the CSIR-funded project at the School of Chemistry, University of Hyderabad.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the UoH JRF post?
faq.answer: The last date for receipt of filled-in applications is 30 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the UoH JRF post?
faq.answer: The essential qualification is M.Sc./Integrated M.Sc. Chemistry/Organic Chemistry or an equivalent degree with 55% marks and valid NET or GATE qualification. Experience in a synthetic organic chemistry lab is desirable.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the UoH JRF post?
faq.answer: The age limit is 28 years. It is relaxable up to 5 years for SC/ST/OBC, women and physically handicapped candidates.

faq.question: Q5. What is the fellowship for the UoH JRF?
faq.answer: The fellowship is Rs. 37,000/- p.m. in the first and second years and Rs. 42,000/- in the third year upon upgradation.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for the UoH JRF post?
faq.answer: Applications go by email to [email protected], on plain paper or in Form B, with self-attested copies of certificates enclosed.

faq.question: Q7. Is the UoH JRF post permanent?
faq.answer: No. The post is temporary and purely contractual in a time-bound CSIR-funded project, and appointees have no right to claim any regular appointment in the University.

faq.question: Q8. How long is the project tenure?
faq.answer: The project tenure is one year, extendable to two more years based on satisfactory performance.

faq.question: Q9. Will TA/DA be paid for the test or joining?
faq.answer: No. The notice says no TA/DA will be paid for attending the written test / skill test or at the time of joining.
